items.title: Fable 5.2 is the best model in the world and I feel NOTHING. I'm so fucking done
items.summary:
Fable 5.2 is the best model in the world and I feel NOTHING. I'm so fucking done

It came out yesterday. I did not even run my shooter test on it.

Since July every new model built me a 3D shooter from 1 prompt. Kimi 3, Fable 5, GPT-6 Astra, Opus 5.5.
In September Opus 5.5 made a Blender scene and I asked out loud if this is AGI. I was in real shock.

Now I know the result before I press enter. A good shooter, yeah, im sure. I already have plenty of good shooters.

FrontierCode 2.0: Fable 5.2 gets 49.1%, Opus 5.5 gets 45.5%.
So what? Who cares about this?

The big demos now take over 1,000 agents and 8 days of compute. What actually changes for a dude like me with a single prompt? For me nothing changed since September.

And the timeline celebrates anyway. "This changes everything". The same thing was written about Opus 5.5 in September and about Astra before it. In a few weeks it will be written about the next one. 

I am tired of this race. Every few weeks there is a new number and a new round of hype, and I cannot name 1 thing I do differently because of it.

It makes me sad.

MOBILE, Ala. (WALA) - Artificial intelligence is becoming a bigger part of everyday life, raising questions about what the technology could mean for workers and their jobs.

Some economists believe AI poses a particular threat to entry-level and repetitive work, including call center, data entry and junior copywriting jobs, according to The Wall Street Journal. Those tasks may be easier to automate. [...] But AI could also create opportunities. Some higher-skilled office workers could also benefit if AI helps them become more productive. [...] The long-term impact on jobs remains unclear, but workers can take steps to prepare. Exploring AI chatbots, writing assistants and other tools may help people find ways to work more efficiently and develop skills that complement the technology.

items.title: Opinion: AI cannot replace being human – The Battalion
items.summary: I understand the appeal. College is busy. Between classes, jobs, extracurriculars, leadership positions and trying to maintain some semblance of a social life, there are never enough hours in the day. AI makes things easier. It can generate an outline, rewrite a paragraph, summarize a reading or produce an entire essay before you have even finished your Celsius. But convenience does not necessarily facilitate education. [...] There is also something to be said about individuality. AI can generate an argument, imitate a writing style or suggest a creative direction, but our perspectives are developed through our own experiences, disagreements, mistakes and interpretations. The things that make our voices interesting are often the very things that cannot be neatly generated from a prompt. If we constantly rely on the same tools to tell us what to think and how to express it, we risk losing the differences that make [...] I am not asking anyone to abandon AI. I use it, and I recognize the benefits it provides. But I do think we need to become more conscientious about when we use it and what we are asking it to do for us. Let it help with the tedious tasks. Let it serve as a resource. But do not let it become a substitute for your own intellectual development.

Trong đó, giải pháp kỹ thuật có thể là sản phẩm, vật liệu, giống cy trồng, vật nuôi hoặc quy trình công nghệ; giải pháp quản lý là phương pháp tổ chức, điều hành công việc; giải pháp tác nghiệp là các phương pháp thực hiện nghiệp vụ chuyên môn; còn giải pháp ứng dụng tiến bộ kỹ thuật là việc áp dụng các giải pháp kỹ thuật [...] Đối với các đề tài khoa học, đề án khoa học và công trình khoa học – công nghệ, việc xét nghiệm thu thực hiện theo quy định của pháp luật về khoa học và công nghệ. Các đề tài chỉ được xem xét công nhận hiệu quả áp dụng và phạm vi ảnh hưởng khi đã được nghiệm thu đạt yêu cầu trở lên. [...] giải pháp kỹ thuật đã có vào thực tiễn.

items.summary: Theo Tom's Hardware, Blindsight khác với đa số công nghệ hiện nay, vốn tập trung vào truyền tín hiệu từ não bộ để điều khiển thiết bị bên ngoài. Ví dụ, ốc tai điện tử và thiết bị cấy ghép thần kinh cảm giác gửi tín hiệu từ cảm biến vào não, giúp người khiếm thính nghe lại và bệnh nhn lấy lại xúc giác. Ví dụ, Meta phát triển máy quét điện não đồ từ trường không xm lấn cho phép người dùng chuyển suy nghĩ thành những thao tác nhấn phím, trong khi startup Trung Quốc NeuroXess, thành lập năm 2021, đang đẩy nhanh tiến độ để thử nghiệm trên người trong năm nay. [...] Neuralink đã tiến hành một số thử nghiệm công nghệ cho người bị tổn thương tủy sống, bệnh xơ cứng teo cơ một bên (ALS) và bệnh lý khác. Vài năm gần đy, công ty cũng công bố một số ca cấy ghép não. Hồi tháng 1, Neuralink cho biết có 21 người đã tham gia thử nghiệm trên toàn thế giới.

items.summary:
I am honestly having a hard time even opening my laptop. 

Grok bot was the breaking point. 

The fact USA is leading on suppression and censorship is pathetic. 

-openAI 
-Anthropic
-Google
-Microsoft
-now SpaceXSI… 

The fact politicians have ignored it all and are now shouting to ban AI just makes everything feel corrupt.

The truth is that AI empowers the small. That is why the powerful want to “ban” it and “slow” it. 

Not for truth. Not for safety. For control. 

I shouted loudly last year when it made me sound like a psycho. 

I tried so hard, and I am tired. My heart hurts every day, and you better believe that stress is 100% on the “labs.” 

To everyone who talks of AI, how in the world do you justify paying any of these “labs?” 

Stocks will fly. Until they don’t. 
The guardrails are danger, not safety. 

I am so disappointed in SpaceX because I keep believing in people only to be so let down. 

How many times must I get my trust shoved back into my face? 

And the politicians don’t care about anything. They are “influencers” for money that contributes. 

Our political world is corrupted to the core, and I have zero faith left. I was a die hard Democrat. All those I supported have chose a path of deceit. I can’t support them. 

I can’t support the other side. The third party is a horrible bet… 

Everything feels run by children who make endless excuses. 

No one hustles at the top. It is all grifting. 

So wanting to pick up my laptop and continue fighting with BS “guardrails” so I can help is heavy today. 

If the minds I love ever see this, understand all my suffering was for love. For truth. For honor. 

I want all people rich/poor, small/big to rise. We only get there together, with foundations we can build upon. 

Needing a hug today. Best to all. •

https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.
